Commentary.Commentary: That's all we have from this one-sided game. Bangladesh are now out of the race for a place in the final in this tri-series but have one last game to play. It's on Thursday, 13th October, against Pakistan at 7.30 am IST (2 am GMT). You can join us in advance for the build-up. Cheers!

Glenn Phillips is the Player of the Match for his scintillating 24-ball 60! He starts by praising Conway's knock and his stand with Guptill that set the platform for him. Mentions that Bangladesh had done their homework on him but he found a way to score. Smiles and admits that he got away with a few mishits. Calls it incredible how they batted as a group in this match.
Presentation time...

It was a clinical outing for the Black Caps with the bat and their bowling was also largely disciplined. Bangladesh did manage to score freely in the Powerplay but the home team kept on picking wickets at regular intervals and never allowed the tourists to gain any kind of momentum. Adam Milne impressed the most with his extra pace and variations, and he finished with three wickets in the end.

It was always going to be a tough chase for Bangladesh but they showed the correct intent right from the word go. A few batters in the top order got starts but they failed to carry on. Shakib Al Hasan was the lone warrior in the end and the tourists will be pleased to have their skipper back in form with the bat.
Easy win for New Zealand and they have booked their place in the final. It's another disappointing outing for Bangladesh but they will take a lot of heart from their improved batting in this game.
Short in length and around off, Mosaddek Hossain pulls it in the air and it drops safely in the deep at mid-wicket. The batters get one run. New Zealand win by 48 runs.
Fuller and on off, this is defended back towards the bowler.
Fuller and wide outside off, Mohammad Saifuddin guides it to point for one.
Shortish and on off, Mosaddek Hossain pulls it to deep mid-wicket for one.
Fuller and on off, this is played towards long on for one.
Slightly shorter and on off, Mosaddek Hossain pulls it to deep mid-wicket for one.
Good length again, slower too. Mohammad Saifuddin looks to play at it but the ball hits the upper part of his bat and bounces off the deck. A dot to end the over.
Good length, on off. Mosaddek Hossain knocks it to mid off for one more.
A full toss and on leg, Mohammad Saifuddin flicks it to mid-wicket for one.
Touch fuller and on off, Mohammad Saifuddin smashes it to covers. Dot.
Mohammad Saifuddin is the new batter.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Tim Southee bowls it slower and wide outside off, Shakib Al Hasan throws his bat to play at it but misses and gets a slight outside edge. Devon Conway, behind the stumps, does the rest and Shakib Al Hasan walks away after scoring an amazing 70 from 44 deliveries.
Commentary.Howout: c Devon Conway b Tim Southee

Commentary.Commentary: On a length and on off, slower too. Mosaddek Hossain guides it to short third man for one.
Tim Southee to bowl his last over. He has been expensive this evening.
Fuller and down leg, Mosaddek Hossain guides it to point for one.
A yorker and on off, Shakib Al Hasan looks to defend it but miscues it to short fine leg. They collect a single.
Slightly shorter this time, Mosaddek Hossain pulls it to deep mid-wicket for one again.
Another fuller one, on off. Shakib Al Hasan flicks it to deep mid-wicket for a run.
Fuller and on off, this is played towards point for one.

Dropped! Touch fuller and on off, Shakib Al Hasan looks to loft it but gets a top edge. The ball carries towards short third man. Blair Tickner (sub) runs backwards to take it but misses and the ball hits his neck. Good attempt. One run taken.
Trent Boult is back into the attack.
Fuller and on off, Shakib Al Hasan guides it to deep point for one.
FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries for Shakib Al Hasan. Touch fuller and on off, Shakib Al Hasan lofts it over mid off for a boundary.
FOUR! Good shot. A low full toss and on off, Shakib Al Hasan shuffles across and flicks it through backward square leg for a boundary.
Slightly shorter and on off, Mosaddek Hossain pulls it but gets a bottom edge. The ball rolls towards mid-wicket. They collect one.
A yorker and on off, Shakib Al Hasan digs it to covers for one.
On a length and outside off, Shakib Al Hasan looks to play at it but misses.
Mosaddek Hossain is the new batter.

OUT! TAKEN! What a catch from Michael Bracewell. This is fuller and on off, Yasir Ali heaves it over mid-wicket. The ball goes up in the air and towards the fence. Michael Bracewell settles just before the fence and takes an amazing catch bending to his left.
Commentary.Howout: c Michael Bracewell b Tim Southee

Commentary.Commentary: Touch fuller and around off, Shakib Al Hasan flicks it to mid-wicket for one.
SIX! Excellent timing. Fuller and on off, Shakib Al Hasan lofts it over long on for a maximum.
Good length again, on off. Yasir Ali eases it to mid off for one.
FOUR! Fine shot. On a length and on off, Yasir Ali pulls it past deep mid-wicket for a boundary.
Slightly shorter and on off, Shakib Al Hasan pulls it to square leg for one. Fifty up for Shakib Al Hasan!
Slower one, full and around off at 116.1 kph, Yasir flicks it in front of square on the leg side for a run. End of a terrific over.
Slower one, full and around leg at 116.1 kph, Yasir flicks it in front of square on the leg side for a run.
Yorker on off, at 143.7 kph, Yasir digs it out to point and looks for a run. He is sent back.
Beaten! A quick full delivery, close to 142 clicks, Yasir is late to bring his bat down and is beaten.
Yasir Ali is the new batter.

OUT! CAUGHT! Milne spears it in full, on middle at 136.6 kph, Nurul tries to heave across the line but it takes the inner half and flies straight into the hands of Glenn Phillips at mid-wicket. He makes no mistake and is all pumped up. The chase is going nowhere for Bangladesh. 89 needed off 34 balls.
Commentary.Howout: c Glenn Phillips b Adam Milne

Commentary.Commentary: Short and wide outside off, Shakib flat-bats it over covers but just for a single.
Adam Milne (2-0-10-2) comes into the attack.
A touch short and on off, Nurul goes back to punch but ends up mistiming it back to the bowler. 4-0-39-2, a decent outing for Michael Bracewell.
Fuller around off, it's driven down to long off for a single.
Short delivery, around off, Nurul cuts it to deep point for a single.
Physio comes out. A mandatory concussion test for Devon Conway after he took a blow on the helmet. He's doing good.
Two wides! Down the leg side, Shakib leaves and the keeper fails to collect. It hits Conway on the helmet and deflects to covers. The batters steal a run.
Fires it flat and full, around leg, Shakib tries to slog-sweep but misses.
FOUR! Picks his spot! Shakib is finding the gaps and boundaries. Short and around off, slower through the air, Shakib waits and hammers it to wide long on for a boundary.
Slider, short and around leg, Shakib turns inside the crease and heaves it behind square leg for two runs.
Perhaps a flipper, going straight on with extra bounce, Nurul tries to play late but doesn't get the connection right. Finds point. 100 needed from the remaining 7 overs.
Googly, full and on middle, Shakib skips down and bunts it to covers for a quick run.
Shortish and outside off, cut to point.
FOUR! Superb batting! Another wrong 'un, on the shorter side around off, Shakib camps back and clobbers it over extra cover for consecutive boundaries.
FOUR! Nice shot! Another googly, this time around off and spinning away, Shakib gives himself room and whacks it over covers for a boundary.
Loopy and full, a googly around leg, Shakib defends off the front foot.
Stays back to punch this short ball outside off but finds the fielder at covers.
On the pads, helped to square leg for a run.
Quicker and flatter around middle and leg, Shakib stays back and defends.
Short in length and outside off, Nurul Hasan goes back and cuts it to deep point for a run.
Nurul Hasan walks in.

OUT! BOWLED! Flighted delivery, landing full around off and skids straight on with the arm, Afif Hossain charges down the track and then tries to defend but misses. It goes through and shatters the stumps. Bangladesh continue to lose wickets at regular intervals. 111 needed off 52 balls.
Walks forward and hits it down to long on for a run.
Physio comes out. Shakib Al Hasan gets his pads replaced.
A googly on off, Afif Hossain works it towards mid-wicket and calls for two. Excellent running.
Fuller again, on middle, Shakib Al Hasan sweeps it to mid-wicket for one again.
Fuller and on off, Afif Hossain sweeps it to square leg for one.
Slightly shorter and on off, Shakib Al Hasan punches it to covers for one.
Turns it around the corner on the leg side and takes one.
Fuller on off, driven to long off for a run.
Drinks break. It's a good attempt from Bangladesh but despite scoring at a healthy run rate, the required rate has stayed over 11. Afif Hossain has joined Shakib Al Hasan in the middle.

OUT! TAKEN! Soumya Sarkar departs for 23. This one lands shorter and outside off, Soumya Sarkar plays an upper cut towards third man but doesn't get enough power on it. Trent Boult settles under it and takes an easy catch. Bangladesh lose a wicket right at the stroke of the drinks break!
Commentary.Howout: c Trent Boult b Adam Milne

Commentary.Commentary: Back of a length and on middle, Shakib Al Hasan pulls it to deep mid-wicket for one.
Shorter again, outside off. Shakib Al Hasan looks to play at it but misses.
Shorter and on middle, Shakib Al Hasan pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
Fuller and on off, Shakib Al Hasan drives it to covers. James Neesham does well to stop it by diving to his left. Dot.
Fuller and outside off, Soumya Sarkar guides it to deep point for one.
Adam Milne is back on. 1 for 6 in his one over so far.
Slightly shorter again, around off. Shakib Al Hasan flicks it to deep mid-wicket for a brace.
Tossed up, on middle, Soumya Sarkar looks to pull it but gets a bottom edge. The ball rolls towards short mid-wicket. They collect one.
Slightly shorter and on leg, Shakib Al Hasan flicks it to short fine leg for one more.
Tossed up on off, Soumya Sarkar sweeps it to square leg for one.
FOUR! Fuller one, down leg. Soumya Sarkar gets on his knee and helps it through to fine leg for a boundary!
Fuller and on off, Shakib Al Hasan guides it to point for one.
Shorter again, Shakib Al Hasan cuts it past point and the batters collect three runs.
Shorter and on off, Soumya Sarkar plays it to deep mid-wicket for one.
FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries. Slightly shorter and on off, Soumya Sarkar plays a reverse sweep over short third man for a boundary!
FOUR! Slightly shorter and on off, Soumya Sarkar slaps it past point for a boundary!
Fuller and on off, played towards mid off for one.

FOUR! Fuller one on off, Shakib Al Hasan gets on his knee and slog sweeps it. The fielder doesn't read the ball quite well at the fence and makes a diving effort behind but just gets his hands on it. The ball falls just before the fence and goes for a boundary.
This one lands outside off, Soumya Sarkar looks to defend it but gets beaten on the outside edge.
Another googly, this one stays a touch low. Soumya Sarkar looks to reverse sweep but misses.
On off, this is driven towards covers for one.
Slightly shorter and down leg, Soumya Sarkar looks to reverse sweep it but misses as the ball hits his thigh pad. A stifled appeal turned down.
A single as this is played towards point.
FOUR! A googly just outside off, Shakib Al Hasan didn't read it and puts his bat, in the end, to guide it to third man for a boundary.
Ish Sodhi is to bowl his leggies now.
Fuller and on middle, Soumya Sarkar miscues his flick shot. It goes off the leading edge to the point fielder. A dot to end the over. 52 for 2 at the end of the Powerplay.
Tossed up, on middle. Shakib Al Hasan flicks it to mid-wicket for one.
FOUR! Fine shot. Fuller and on off, Shakib Al Hasan uses his feet and lofts it over mid on for a boundary!
Shakib Al Hasan is the new batter.

OUT! CAUGHT! Another one bites the dust. This one lands fuller and on off, Litton Das gets on his knee to loft it but doesn't get the power right. The ball goes up in the air towards deep mid-wicket. Martin Guptill settles under it and pouches it in his safe hands. Litton Das looked good during his stay but failed to contribute much.
Commentary.Howout: c Martin Guptill b Michael Bracewell

Commentary.Commentary: Touch fuller and on off, Soumya Sarkar slaps it past the diving fielder at point. They collect three runs.
Tossed up, down leg. Litton Das slog-sweeps it to deep backward square leg for one.
Michael Bracewell is into the attack.
Outside off, pushed to covers for a run. 14 from the over.
Four leg byes! Angling down the leg side, on a length, Das fails to flick and it goes off his pads to the fence at fine leg.
SIX! Not from the middle of the bat but it has cleared the fence. Short in length on middle, Das stays back to pull and does so off the top edge. It goes over fine leg for a biggie.
Mid-wicket drops back.
A length ball on middle, following the batter, Das pushes it down to mid on.
Short and wide outside off, Sarkar plays late to beat Sodhi at short third man but Ish makes the stop with a dive. They cross for a run.
Slightly short and around leg, Sarkar swings it behind square leg and collects two runs.
FOUR! Full in length and outside off, Litton Das gets forward and blazes it over extra cover for a cracking boundary.

NOT OUT! Milne spears it in, very full and around leg, Sarkar is late into his flick shot and is rapped on the pads. They appeal but the finger stays down. It takes some time to convince Tim Southee and he takes the referral. Nothing on the UltraEdge and the Ball Tracking shows that it had PITCHED OUTSIDE LEG. New Zealand waste one review.
LBW shout not entertained. DRS time...
Play and a miss! Another sharp delivery. Short in length and outside off, Sarkar stands back and tries to slam it over point but misses.
Soumya Sarkar walks in next.

OUT! MIDDLE STUMP UPROOTED! Fast and furious from Adam Milne. He clocks 150 kph and delivers it on a good length around middle and leg. Najmul Hossain Shanto stands back to heave it over the leg side but his bat comes down late. The ball demolishes the middle pole and New Zealand have the first breakthrough.
Tries to drive but gets an inside edge onto the pads. It deflects to point and they cross.

Dropped! Fuller in length, around middle, Shanto tries to go downtown but it comes off the inner part of his bat. Tim Southee reacts to his right at mid on but puts down a simple catch. The batters cross.
Adam Milne comes into the attack.
FOUR! With the swing goes Litton. Fuller in length on middle, shaping into the batter, Litton Das picks it up and whips it over mid-wicket for a boundary.
Knuckle delivery, with the seam up. It lands full around off, Shanto pushes it towards extra cover and crosses.
FOUR! Put away! Trent Boult digs it in short, around middle, Najmul Hossain Shanto rides the bounce and pulls it powerfully to the deep square leg fence.
Shortish and outside off, played down to point.

Fuller and around off, Shanto drives it straight back and it goes on to hit the stumps at the other end. The non-striker is out of the crease and Boult tries to inflict a run out by gathering the ball and uprooting the stumps but by then, Litton Das is back in safely.
Sloppy from New Zealand. Very full around leg, Das fails to flick and it goes off his pads to square leg. James Neesham has a shy at the bowler's end but misses. They cross for a leg bye.
Fullish around off, shaping in, Shanto brings his bat down and defends it on the leg side.
FOUR! Well played! Another inswinger from Southee, on a length around middle, this time Shanto swings his bat and sends it behind square leg for a boundary.

Shout for an lbw! Southee delivers it on middle, on a good length and gets it to move into the batter late, Shanto goes nowhere as he tries to play from the crease. Misses and is hit on the pads. They appeal but to no avail. Missing leg.
Steps down the track and tucks it towards short fine leg for a single.
FOUR! Shot! Southee pitches it up and outside off, Litton Das gets forward and smacks it over covers for a boundary.
Inswinger this time, landing on a length around middle, Das steps back but is cramped for room and ends up defending it back.
Wide! An outswinger, it starts from outside off and the batter leaves it.
Tim Southee to bowl from the other end.
Fuller and around leg, it's clipped to deep square leg for a single.
Around off, defended to covers.
Outside off, Das tries to drive but misses.

WHAT HAPPENED THERE? A complete breakdown in communication. Back of a length, around middle and straightening a bit, Najmul Hossain Shanto tries to heave but gets a top edge straight up in the air towards the off side. Trent Boult, Tim Southee from mid off, Glenn Phillips from covers, and Devon Conway from behind the stumps go for it. They all leave it for each other and the ball drops safely. Very poor. Conway apologizes as he was calling for the catch but didn't go for it. The batters cross.
Boult goes full around off, angling in, Najmul Hossain Shanto gets behind the line and blocks it down.
A hint of swing there! Full in length and outside off, Shanto gets forward and pushes it to covers.
